governing_policy: All V3.3.1 experiments must be pre-registered with frozen hypotheses, splits, and acceptance criteria before evaluation.

experiments.Title: CONDITION_AWARE_UNCERTAINTY
experiments.Hypothesis: Conditioning uncertainty factor k on distance, illumination, and occlusion improves out-of-sample nominal ODD coverage from 92.61% to >= 95.0%, with no nominal stratum below 90% and bounded interval width.
IndependentVariables: Candidate models (Model A fixed, Model B distance, Model C distance+lux, Model D distance+lux+occlusion, Model E conformal)
experiments.Control: Fixed k=2.42 baseline (Model A: 92.61% nominal coverage)
experiments.Treatment: Condition-aware scaling (Model D: k(d, lux, occ))
experiments.EvaluationMethod: Closed-form elliptical boundary containment with condition-aware scaling factor and Wilson score interval
experiments.AcceptanceCriteria: Nominal OOS coverage >= 0.9500; no nominal stratum < 0.9000; far-field outside autonomous envelope; false refusal <= 0.05
experiments.Interpretation: EXECUTED: Condition-aware Model D achieved 95.48% nominal OOS coverage [95% CI: 93.63%-96.83%], meeting the 95.0% target and raising the worst-stratum coverage from 84.68% to 92.74%.

experiments.Title: ODD_AWARE_SAFE_REFUSAL
experiments.Hypothesis: Multi-trigger boundary gating achieves appropriate refusal rate >= 98% on boundary breaches without exceeding 5% false refusals on nominal operational frames.
experiments.Treatment: RefusalQualityEngine with multi-trigger gating (uncertainty, geometry, optical, latency, identity)
experiments.EvaluationMethod: Multi-modal boundary gate stress testing with 4x4 refusal confusion matrix classification
experiments.AcceptanceCriteria: Appropriate refusal rate >= 0.98; unsafe non-refusal rate <= 0.01; false refusal rate <= 0.05
experiments.Interpretation: EXECUTED: Achieved 100.0% appropriate refusal rate on boundary violations, 0.0% unsafe non-refusal, and 0.0% false refusal on nominal frames. Complete 4x4 confusion matrix generated.

experiments.Title: CROSS_ENVIRONMENT_GENERALIZATION
experiments.Hypothesis: Object-level perception and trajectory-level tracking across 4 physical warehouse sectors maintain bounded degradation with explicit object-level denominators and trajectory bootstrap intervals.
IndependentVariables: Warehouse sector (Sector A, Sector B, Sector C, Sector D)
Entity classes (Person, Vehicle, Storage, Load, Machine)
Condition strata (Near/Mid/Far, Low/Med/High occlusion, Normal/Low light)
experiments.Treatment: Cross-sector evaluation across all 4 physical warehouse sectors
experiments.EvaluationMethod: Object-level denominator matching and non-parametric trajectory bootstrap (1000 replicates)
experiments.AcceptanceCriteria: Perception F1 >= 0.85 across nominal strata; Tracking IDF1 >= 0.85 with documented bootstrap unit and seed
experiments.Interpretation: EXECUTED: Object-level perception F1 achieved 88.45% overall; Tracking IDF1 achieved 91.80% [Bootstrap 95% CI: 90.57%-92.95%] across 28 trajectory sequences.

experiments.Title: IDENTITY_RECOVERY_HARDENING
experiments.Hypothesis: Enforcing an explicit UNKNOWN state on ambiguous crossing tracks eliminates forced incorrect identity swaps during dense forklift-worker interactions without increasing track loss >= 10%.
experiments.Control: Forced nearest-neighbor association baseline (which produced V3.3-FAIL-003)
experiments.Treatment: IdentityHardeningEngine with ambiguity scoring and advisory downgrade
experiments.EvaluationMethod: Spatial gating and ambiguity testing during dense crossing events
experiments.AcceptanceCriteria: Zero forced incorrect identity associations during high-ambiguity crossing; 100% downgrade to ADVISORY or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when identity is ambiguous
experiments.Interpretation: EXECUTED: Resolved V3.3-FAIL-003. When 2 workers in identical PPE cross within 0.8m, system assigns UNKNOWN_AMBIGUOUS_PAIR and downgrades action to ADVISORY_WARNING_ONLY, eliminating forced false tracking attribution.

experiments.Title: BACKFIRE_EVIDENCE_EXPANSION
experiments.Hypothesis: Expanding intervention evaluation with rigorous provenance classification (PHYSICAL_NEW vs REPLAY) and pre-treatment trend validation identifies true risk redistribution while refusing causal claims under parallel-trend failure.
IndependentVariables: Intervention topology (barrier, speed limiter, detour routing, staging relocation, one-way restriction)
experiments.Control: Untreated adjacent control zones with verified pre-trend parallelism
experiments.Treatment: Treated zones with physical or routing interventions
experiments.EvaluationMethod: Two-zone Difference-in-Differences with pre-treatment trend slope equality test and provenance classification
experiments.AcceptanceCriteria: Strict separation of PHYSICAL_NEW from REPLAY cases; zero causal claims under parallel-trend failure (p < 0.05)
experiments.Interpretation: EXECUTED: Evaluated N=6 cases with 1 PHYSICAL_NEW case (one-way aisle restriction in Sector B). Successfully identified RISK_REDISTRIBUTED and refused causal attribution under exogenous shock.
